name: Bharat Dynamics Ltd.
about: Bharat Dynamics Limited manufactures and sells guided missiles, underwater weapons, air-borne products, and allied defense equipment in India. The company offers light weight torpedoes, Varunastra or heavy-weight torpedoes, medium-range surface-to-air missile, dishani, quick reaction surface-to-air missile, multi-influential ground mines, vertically launched-short range surface-to-air missile, flame, Konkurs launcher test equipment, Akash and Astra weapon systems, Konkurs missile test equipment, anti-submarine warfare suite, counter measures dispensing system, smart anti-airfield weapon, anti-torpedo decoy launching system, Helina, Amogha, man portable ATGM, NAG ATGM, Invar, Konkurs-M ATGM, Milan2T ATGM, and unified launchers. It also exports its products. Bharat Dynamics Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~35% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~6% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
Trades at PE 81 vs sector median 46; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 46, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
